children: Germany has discussed with industry the idea of mandatory gas storage filling for next year, which could mean imposing minimum filling quotas on either utilities, power plant operators or traders, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
